cases.condition: Any request or claim-map string contains a private local path, email, credential-like assignment, or other forbidden sensitive text.
cases.minimum_next_action: Replace the first sensitive value with an anonymized label and create a new request file.

cases.condition: An input is a symlink, hard link, non-regular file, oversized, changes during the single-fd read, or the output aliases any input path or inode.
cases.minimum_next_action: Copy immutable input bytes to new single-link regular files and choose a fresh output label.

cases.condition: The request claim-map SHA-256 does not equal the hash of the exact raw claim-map bytes read by the CLI.
cases.minimum_next_action: Recompute the request reference from unchanged raw claim-map bytes without reserialization.

cases.condition: A source gate is a thin self-declaration or omits the canonical actor, evidence, timestamp, decisiveness, finding, or limitation fields.
cases.minimum_next_action: Replace the thin gate with one complete canonical gate record and regenerate its claim map.

cases.condition: A selected source claim has any level above no_positive_claim, even when its self-declared status and gates say supported or pass.
cases.minimum_next_action: Validate the selected positive claim through production bundle semantics before any report rendering.

cases.condition: A selected claim is blocked, rejected, not assessed, or lacks nonempty evidence and gate linkage.
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve the first unsupported selected claim in a new canonical claim map.

cases.condition: A selected claim evidence ID is absent, missing, unhashed, or not a canonical present record or file item.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind the first missing selected evidence item as present content-addressed evidence.

cases.condition: A selected claim references a missing gate or a gate whose status is not pass or justified not-applicable.
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve the first non-passing decisive gate without editing the generated plan.

cases.condition: Selected official-source evidence lacks one bounded source label and page, section, table, figure, or equation locator.
cases.minimum_next_action: Add one bounded locator for the first unresolved official-source evidence ID.

cases.condition: A selected claim is not mapped to any report section after all claim, evidence, gate, and citation checks pass.
cases.minimum_next_action: Map the first omitted selected claim to exactly one intended report section.

cases.condition: The request selects bilingual rendering before a reviewed claim-preserving bilingual adapter exists.
cases.minimum_next_action: Select one source language for this candidate-local report plan.

cases.condition: A selected claim ID does not resolve in the exact supplied claim map.
cases.minimum_next_action: Replace the first unresolved selection with one existing no-positive claim ID.

cases.condition: All exact-byte, privacy, shape, no-positive claim, evidence, gate, citation, section, and draft-authority checks pass.
cases.minimum_next_action: Audit the unchanged no-positive report plan before creating a local JSON draft package.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established from the supplied bounded evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop fail closed and request one exact canonical report request plus its bound claim map.
